summary: Lean 4 formalization of three Poisson-limit statements for the starting points of long constant stretches of an extended Rademacher random completely multiplicative function in a dyadic block, corresponding to the three clauses of Theorem 1.2 in the cited source article. The first proves a total-variation Poisson approximation uniformly over every deterministic mask of the dyadic block. The second gives the Laplace-functional characterization of the limiting spatial Poisson point process.
